        station_id,

survivors AS (

        station_name,
        borough_name,

WITH station_trip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.station_id,
        s.station_name,
        b.borough_name,
        COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bike_id) AS distinct_bikes_used,
        AVG(t.duration_sec) AS avg_duration_sec,
        MAX(t.distance_km) AS max_distance_km,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.member_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS casual_trip_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreturned_trip_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN bm.is_electric = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS electric_trip_ratio
    FROM stations AS s
    JOIN boroughs AS b
      ON b.borough_id = s.borough_id
    LEFT JOIN trips AS t
      ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
    LEFT JOIN bikes AS bk
      ON bk.bike_id = t.bike_id
    LEFT JOIN bike_models AS bm
      ON bm.model_id = bk.model_id
    GROUP BY
        s.station_id,
        s.station_name,
        b.borough_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN trip_count = 0 THEN 'no_activity'
            WHEN electric_trip_ratio >= 0.6 THEN 'electric_heavy'
            WHEN casual_trip_count * 1.0 / trip_count >= 0.5 THEN 'casual_heavy'
            ELSE 'mixed_usage'
        END AS usage_label,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY trip_count DESC) AS busiest_station_rank
    FROM station_trip_stats
)
SELECT
    station_id AS station_id,
    station_name AS station_name,
    borough_name AS borough_name,
    trip_count AS trip_count,
    distinct_bikes_used AS distinct_bikes_used,
    ROUND(casual_trip_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(trip_count, 0), 4) AS casual_trip_ratio,
    ROUND(avg_duration_sec, 2) AS avg_duration_sec,
    ROUND(max_distance_km, 2) AS max_distance_km,
    ROUND(electric_trip_ratio, 4) AS electric_trip_ratio,
    ROUND(unreturned_trip_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(trip_count, 0), 4) AS unreturned_trip_ratio,
    usage_label AS usage_label,
    busiest_station_rank AS busiest_station_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY trip_count DESC, station_id

    1.0 * COALESCE(pmt.promo_member_trip_count, 0) / NULLIF(tc.all_trip_count, 0),
    4

FROM trip_counts AS tc
